test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"surface". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Surface refers to the outer or the top layer of something where activities can occur.
 
• With regards to the eye, light must be focused on the surface of the retina, which makes this the most appropriate term to use in this setting.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read: "It is necessary to focus the scattered light at the retina's surface."
 
 
• The lens and cornea of the eye together focus incoming light onto the surface of the retina, where the light-sensitive cells are stimulated and send signals to the brain to form an image.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "lane" - This word generally refers to a narrow road or a defined path for vehicles or people to travel through.
 
 
• The retina in the eye doesn't have lanes; it's an organ with a surface which receives light, so this option doesn't fit.
 
 
 
• "side" - In this context, "side" could refer to either the left or right side, front or back, etc.
 
 
• However, in terms of the eye's anatomy and particularly the retina, it is not accurate. Light is focused on the surface of the retina, not on a specific side.
 
 
 
• "top" - This could imply a location on a higher point or area, which does not make sense in the context of focusing scattered light in the eye.
